frontmatter.summary: Before a build has a film to play, should the viewer keep drawing the scene from its content (W4), or show a plain placeholder like the strip.
frontmatter.recommendation: Yes: the viewer shares the W4 drawing, and before a build it is the only picture there is; the strip shows the placeholder.
